landManager: Northwoods Alliance · Wildcat Falls Community Forest

landManager.note: Owner identifies itself as owner and manager of Wildcat Falls Community Forest.

publicAccess.note: Community forest established for perpetual public non-motorized access.

parking.note: From Watersmeet US-45 to County Rd 206/Sucker Lake Rd, north on County Line Lake Rd, 0.6 miles north of McGinty Lane look for yellow trail sign on left. Roadside parking described, but precise parking coordinate, plowing and present shoulder conditions not supplied.

trail.note: Owner says 3/4-mile yellow-marked waterfall trail with uneven topography, cedar/hemlock and outcrops; whether one-way or total is not specified. No driving or route geometry to falls pin.

location.note: Regional tourism brochure #29 provides an approximate Wildcat Falls feature coordinate; owner trail map location not independently georeferenced. Never issue vehicle directions or survey-grade trail marker from this position.

discrepancy.claim: No maintained trail; off-trail navigation from creek crossing
discrepancy.resolution: Contradicted by the land manager's more authoritative explicitly marked yellow visitor trail. Do not use legacy bushwhack directions.
